title: New Tai Reader Basic Book (Chow Khouk Manpoong)
author: Chow Khouk Manpoong, M.A. & Tai Literature Committee
description: Foundational curriculum textbook published by the Tai Literature Committee at Chongkham, approved by the Arunachal Bhikkhu Sangha and educational directorates for teaching Tai literacy, syllabary, tone distinctions, and daily conversation across Assam and Arunachal Pradesh.
